description:
## Empirical anchor

Arc 24 CATO verdict noted: 'the design §3.1 Step 3 template + §6.1 §5.8.3 template + §3.4 prose carry the python-vs-jq rationale in three near-identical places (drift risk per design §13.4)'.

Surfaced 2026-05-13 in Arc 24 design.md by CATO during Phase 3 cold-read. Non-blocking; ARC 25+ single-source-of-truth lift is the right home.

## Substrate touch-point

The python poll-loop template is referenced in:
- substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md §5.8 (canonical template)
- substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §7.6 (cross-ref to PLINY)
- substrate/operating-disciplines.md §18 (or wherever Arc 24 landed the universal subagent-status section)
- substrate/skills/agent-author/SKILL.md (template authoring discipline)

The rationale for python-over-jq (portability, no jq dependency, stdlib only, better error handling) appears in 3 near-identical locations across these files. Risk: future edits to one location drift from others.

## Fix shape

Lift the rationale prose into a single canonical location (probably operating-disciplines.md §18 sub-section, or a new substrate/templates/canonical-poll-loop.md doc), and have other locations cross-reference it. Single source of truth.

## Gauntlet

ADA + CATO eyeball. Substrate doc-only edit; ~30-50 LOC of consolidation.

## Sequencing

P3. Arc 25+. Substrate-hygiene refactor, not blocking new work.
title: Arc 24 follow-up — python-vs-jq rationale single-source-of-truth lift (design §13.4 drift)
